messages:
lina: Customer reported an unexpected delta between dashboard and invoice for embeddings+rerank yesterday, small account, ~3k requests but invoice shows ~9k units charged. Asking for quick triage.
raj: can you paste the sample payloads or an event id? any indication of pairwise vs single embeddings? :eyes: 
lina: user sent batch of ~200 inputs to /v1/embeddings with mode=pairwise-rerank, batch_size=64, truncate_to=256. They said some long inputs got truncated. Attached minimal repro from their side: `inputs.csv` not included here.
raj: hm pairwise + truncation + batch splitting could lead to weird accounting if we count pre-split and post-split items. Can you request a billing export for the time window? @matt please watch for spikes.
matt: pulling events now. replay-bot: created replay id=rep-20240512-9823 for account acct_47, window=2024-05-11T22:00..2024-05-11T23:00.
raj: quick check — did the client send request_id or idempotency keys? if not, retries + split might double-count.
lina: client claims only one submit, no retries. They included request_id header for each original batch. But our routing splits into 2 internal sub-batches (64 -> 64 -> 72) because of char-level truncation and alignment.
matt: billing export shows 3x the expected vector-gen events for that account during the window. pattern: each original input has one "original" event and 1-2 "split" events with same request_id but different internal txn ids.
raj: aha. looks like our metering pipeline deduplicates only on external request_id + route, but when truncation changes seq_len we create new internal record and fail to tag it as duplicate. Proposed quick patch: in metering, treat sub-batches produced from the same request_id as dedupable by original_input_hash if present.
lina: can you repro locally? steps?
raj: repro steps I used:
```
# generate 200 long texts
python tools/mk_inputs.py --count 200 --length 1500 > inputs.jsonl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"mode":"pairwise-rerank","truncate_to":256,"batch_size":64,"request_id":"test-dup-1","inputs": <file contents> }'
```
Then watch /internal/metering/events for duplicate events. I see original + two split events for ~22% of inputs.
matt: root cause seems to be batch-split happening after truncation stage but before dedupe tagging. billing-bot: flagged 2.9k anomalous charges for acct_47, created ticket BG-3245.
raj: I'll open a quick hotfix to tag sub-batches with original_request_id and input_hash before they hit metering. rollback plan: revert tagging if it causes any perf regressions.
lina: customer asked for interim credits while we fix — can billing issue a temporary credit for the delta? @matt
matt: will propose credit of difference and hold invoice until fix lands, will confirm in BG-3245. :thumbsup:
raj: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/p/metering/+/9873 — adds dedupe key generation from request_id + input_hash. Rolling patch to staging in 15m, prod in 2h after smoke.
lina: thanks. I'll reply to customer with repro steps and that we're investigating, offering credits pending confirmation.
raj: follow-up action items: 1) add unit test for split-after-truncate scenario, 2) add ingestion-time assertion to ensure dedupe key exists for every internal event, 3) monitor invoices for next cycle.
matt: logging BG-3245 with credit decision TBC.
lina: marking resolved for now, will reopen if customer sees continued discrepancy. :white_check_mark:
